real_defects.issue: --audit-commit counted any APPROVED review ever left on the PR: an owner approval later withdrawn (CHANGES_REQUESTED or DISMISSED) or given to an older commit than the merged head still passed. Reproduced with mocked reviews (audit_verdict returned 0 for all three). Fix and tests written (current_approvers: latest decisive review per login, commit_id must equal pr.head.sha). Control plane, so it goes in its own PR from claude/cool-franklin-d9clqm after #15724 lands; patch also in that branch's history.

--audit-commit read only the first page of GET /commits/{sha} files (300 per page), so a squash touching 301+ files could hide an owned file on page 2. Reproduced with a mocked two-page response (main returned 0). Fix (commit_files pages up to 10x300) with a failing-first test is in the same control-plane follow-up PR.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
